name: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell at each side with palms facing inward.
Step one foot diagonally back behind your standing leg onto the ball of your foot while keeping your hips facing forward.
Bend both knees smoothly to lower your hips until your front thigh approaches parallel and your rear knee nears the floor.
Drive through your front foot to return to standing and alternate legs on each repetition.
tips: Keep your front knee aligned over your toes rather than twisting inward as your back leg crosses.
Keep your chest proud and hips squared forward throughout the descent and return.
